name: Shuka
source:
The Chinese-style world of Shenhua. Young queen rules the country of Shonan where spirits worship is practiced and theater plays are main means of entertainment. 
Main character is an actor who appears in this world after following a disappeared actress in his dream.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
中国风世界“神华”中，信奉灵魂崇拜、以戏剧表演为主要娱乐的湘南国，由年轻女王统治。
主人公是一名演员；追随梦中失踪的女演员后，他来到这个世界。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
